description: This file defines a PHP class 'Jjwg_MapsViewGeocoded_Counts' that extends SugarView and generates an HTML report page displaying geocoding counts, module links, and instructions related to the 'jjwg_Maps' module in SugarCRM. It renders a table of geocoding data, URLs for geocoding and exporting addresses, and includes instructions and links for cron jobs and cache management.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewGeocoded_Counts
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering geocoded counts and related information within the SugarCRM 'jjwg_Maps' module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the HTML content displaying geocoded counts, module links, URLs for geocoding, address export, and cache deletion options.
